new file mode 100644
index 0000000..17633bf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fetchit/table.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import json
+
+
+def _cell(v) -> str:
+    if isinstance(v, str):
+        return v
+    if v is None:
+        return ""
+    return json.dumps(v)
+
+
+def render_table(rows) -> str:
+    """Aligned text table for a list of dicts: one column per key, in first-seen order."""
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not all(isinstance(r, dict) for r in rows):
+        raise ValueError("--table needs a JSON list of objects")
+    cols = []
+    for r in rows:
+        for k in r:
+            if k not in cols:
+                cols.append(k)
+    if not cols:
+        return ""
+    body = [[_cell(r.get(c)) for c in cols] for r in rows]
+    widths = [max(len(c), *(len(b[i]) for b in body)) for i, c in enumerate(cols)]
+    lines = [[str(c) for c in cols]] + body
+    return "\n".join(
+        "  ".join(cell.ljust(w) for cell, w in zip(line, widths)).rstrip() for line in lines
+    )

new file mode 100644

+++ b/tests/test_table.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import pytest
+
+from fetchit.table import render_table
+
+
+def test_render_table_aligns_columns():
+    out = render_table([{"id": 1, "name": "apple"}, {"id": 22, "name": "fig"}])
+    assert out.splitlines() == ["id  name", "1   apple", "22  fig"]
+
+
+def test_render_table_unions_keys():
+    out = render_table([{"a": 1}, {"b": "x"}])
+    assert out.splitlines() == ["a  b", "1", "   x"]
+
+
+def test_render_table_rejects_non_list():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        render_table({"a": 1})
